The '''Minos Cluster Trade Authority''' was an organization responsible for overseeing trade within the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Renea Luies]] was well versed in the Minos Cluster Trade Authority's [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] workings.
